source.name: Back-derived from Labour Party's own 2026 CGT costing
source.assumptions: No public taxable-capital-gains dataset exists for NZ. This 'value' is back-calculated from Labour's own steady-state CGT revenue projection ($969m/year) at their proposed 28% rate: 969,000,000 / 0.28 = $3,460,714,286 of taxable investment-property gains per year. This is only as credible as Labour's own costing - not an independently sourced base. See TODO.md.
